svg.title: NET-03-P — Common editable Direct setup
svg.desc: Existing 850 by 700 logical desktop canvas. Unbound Direct setup for either hosting lifecycle on all four approved clients. Fixed banner, noninteractive Direct context, editable Address with initial focus, separate Port and optional Password, two independently scrolling ordinary local setup panels, persistent feedback and centered Connect/Back. No Service type row, crypto choice, platform warning, certificate task, or premature role/identity claim. Endpoint values illustrate the ordinary loopback setup, not a deployed dedicated default.

g.text: Local players: 1 • Session-only scores • Optional scripts disabled
Endpoint-only first contact does not authenticate host identity.
ANNOTATIONS: Address → Port → Password → local setup → Connect → Back; reverse reverses the cycle.
Focused fields scroll text; body lists scroll independently. Keep header, validation and footer fixed.
Password stays optional and masked when entered. No selector target or pre-admission controller claim.
All four approved clients use this Direct task. Browser binding remains NET-03-E / NET-03-B.
